text:
sophie: Heads up 1: we need a compact "Inference Playbook" mini-visual pack for next week's webinar + an inbound-routing one-pager. Deliverables: hero tile, two benchmark microcards (cost vs latency), one-slide routing matrix, sticker-checklist set. Deadline: Tue EOD. Please branch the Figma file and add alt-text notes. https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/Inference-Playbook
ben: Who owns final copy and messaging? Confirm export sizes + color variants.
maria: I'll own copy. Two message hooks incoming. Variants: brand-blue and dark-reverse high contrast.
jake: Routing needs per-channel CTA examples and sample UTMs. Example UTM: utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=inference_playbook
sophie: Export sizes: hero_web 1200x628, hero_social 1080x1080, slide 1920x1080, microcards 800x800, stickers 360x360. Provide alt-text file per asset.
maria: Hook A: "Serve smarter 1 cut inference unit cost by up to 2x."
maria: Hook B: "Predictable latency. Predictable cost. Redwood Inference."
ben: Add a one-line explainer for Hosted / Dedicated / Private on the hero or microcard. Also include a tiny SLA badge for Dedicated examples.
legal-bot: Include trademark line: "Redwood Inference and the Redwood logo are trademarks of Redwood Inference, Inc." If using 3rd-party model names add: "Model names are trademarks of their respective owners." Send final exports to legal for sign-off.
designbot: Created branch "playbook-mini/1778879999-sophie" and uploaded initial frames. Tags: #playbook #webinar #miniassets
ben: Export spec: PNGs for social, SVGs for icons, and a PPTX slide. Filenaming: playbook_hero_web_v1.png etc. Accessibility: color contrast >=4.5:1 for body copy. Provide keyboard-focus outline for interactive stickers.
sophie: Exact filenames in Figma notes. Please modularize components for localization. Priority: 1) hero web + social, 2) slide + routing matrix, 3) microcards, 4) sticker checklist. First pass in 48h for rehearsal.
designbot: First-pass frames uploaded. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/Inference-Playbook?node-id=branch-playbook-mini
ben: I'll review and leave comments. If blockers surface I'll flag them here.
sophie: Thanks all 1 ping here with blockers. :rocket:
